name: Judging People
overview: Scripture instructs believers to exercise careful and righteous judgment rather than condemning others harshly or superficially. Jesus teaches in Matthew and Luke not to judge or condemn so that we ourselves will not face judgment or condemnation, emphasizing forgiveness as a key response. At the same time, believers are called to discern rightly, avoiding false appearances as John 7:24 and Luke 12:57 highlight the need to judge what is truly right, not merely by outward show. Proverbs 10:18 warns against deceitful speech that hides hatred, reminding us that judgment involves honesty and wisdom rather than slander.
